The reported abundance of bismuth in the Earth's crust varies significantly by source from 180ppb (similar to that of silver) to 8ppb (twice as common as gold). The most important [[Wikipedia:ore|ore]]s of bismuth are [[Wikipedia:bismuthinite|bismuthinite]] and [[Wikipedia:bismite|bismite]]. [[wikipedia:Native element mineral|Native]] bismuth is known from Raledria, Dahe, and Isnti.
